abstract: The Impact of Genomic Variation on Function (IGVF) Consortium has utilized a wide variety of assays and computational methods to study how genomic variation impacts function. To support the collaborative efforts of labs within IGVF, and to share the results of these efforts, the IGVF Data Administration and Coordination Center (DACC) has developed a data portal (https://data.igvf.org/) that serves as the repository for all results from the IGVF Consortium and as the source of results that have been integrated into the IGVF knowledge graph. Data generated by the IGVF Consortium, which has reached over 240 terabytes as of November 2026, can be publicly accessed via web browser, or programmatically via API, as well as via agentic tools. Here, we provide a summary of the available IGVF data and an overview of the design of the IGVF Data Portal.
